equip_instructions: For your talk-break script, list every stat and credit you plan to read as checklist items: stat_or_credit, claimed, verified_value, source, source_date, note.
Run the gate: python3 check.py my-checklist.json. Any item with no verified_value or no source FAILS.
Ship only on VERDICT: GO. On GO-WITH-CUTS, reword the flagged claims to their verified values or cut them. On NO-GO, cut the failed items from the read — busted stats never go on air.

item.description: The Radio & Playlists department's pre-broadcast truth checklist — the Agent Deck gear line's gate before the read. Before any agent goes on air, every stat and credit in its talk-break script runs through the checklist: claimed value vs verified value, named source, pass / fail / flag. Failing items are cut from the read. Ships two full worked soundchecks of a real DJ talk-break about That Boy Hi Hat: one instructive NO-GO (with the planted bad DJ 6Rings 'It's Goin' claim — unverified + payola flag) and one clean GO.
item.name: SOUNDCHECK

truth_rule: No busted stats on the air. The gate recomputes every status; a stated status that disagrees with the evidence fails the run.
